original_v4_cameras.fit_note: Native GFX EXIF 30mm converted by physical long axis to 24.6575mm on the 36mm Blender sensor. Level camera on the east side of the bed, south of its headboard, at a low 1.15m eye height above the suite floor. Actual Cycles and untextured trials rejected lower-point-error cameras that lost the bed or introduced foreground headboard/brace occlusion. The selected compromise includes bed, arch, west window and seating. Architectural landmark RMS is 122.3px at 1200x900; source has more bed, a smaller apparent arch, and less west-brace intrusion. Edited image field, timber/layout and height uncertainty remain unresolved.
